custom_information.note: 1075 ratio and nulls are recorded non-gating per rec-20260923-98a4da88

interpretation.label: alpha_world_amplifies_present_action_read
interpretation.combination_rule: Per seed, a paired row bootstrap (2000 resamples, 95% CI) on d_act(0.9) - d_act(0.3), d_act = (SSE_swap - SSE_true)/(SSE_swap + SSE_true) on the burn-in battery (analytic null 0): CI lower > 0 -> grows, CI upper < 0 -> shrinks, else cannot_determine; a seed whose positive control is not live at either alpha, or whose rows are not aligned, is cannot_determine. GROWS if >= 2 seeds grow; SHRINKS if >= 2 seeds shrink; otherwise UNDETERMINED. Every precondition must be met or the run self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue. outcome PASS iff GROWS or SHRINKS. LABEL SPLITS (red-team, interpretation only; counts unchanged): GROWS is alpha_world_amplifies_present_action_read if the 0.3 cell already reads its action (d_act CI lower > 0) on >= 2 growing seeds, else alpha_world_damping_masked_action_read; SHRINKS is attributed to the encoder (action_read_not_raised_by_alpha_encoder_leg) only if the paired positive-control contrast pc_d_act(0.9) - pc_d_act(0.3) has CI upper <= 0 on >= 2 shrinking seeds, else action_read_shrinks_head_fit_confound. The alpha 1.0 contrast, the V3-EXQ-1075 battery ratio and its nulls, the head/PC readability ratio, and the persistence verdict are RECORDED and do not gate.

preconditions.name: battery_rows
preconditions.description: worst cell's burn-in battery row count (either battery)

preconditions.name: battery_distinct_actions
preconditions.description: worst cell's distinct actions in the burn-in battery (a 1-action battery makes the swap undefined)

preconditions.name: alpha_batteries_row_aligned
preconditions.description: seeds whose burn-in battery rows are the SAME env transitions at 0.3 and 0.9 (the paired contrast is undefined otherwise)
preconditions.control: same seed, same action rng, alpha-independent env

preconditions.name: positive_control_live_seeds
preconditions.description: READINESS (same statistic as the criterion): seeds where a linear action-aware predictor fitted on the cell's own P0 buffer scores d_act CI lower > 0 on the same burn-in battery at BOTH 0.3 and 0.9. A seed failing this is scoped out of routing (cannot_determine), not failed
preconditions.control: ridge z0 + [1, z0, a, z0 x a] @ W; reads its action by construction wherever z_world carries linearly readable action information

criteria.name: C1_determinate_alpha_contrast
criteria.description: max(seeds growing, seeds shrinking) on the paired d_act(0.9) - d_act(0.3) CI; >= 2 of 3 gives a determinate verdict

criteria.name: C1a_seeds_grow
criteria.description: seeds whose contrast CI lies entirely above 0 (GROWS route)

criteria.name: C1b_seeds_shrink
criteria.description: seeds whose contrast CI lies entirely below 0 (SHRINKS route)
